title: Nonpersistence of full-dimensional tori with polynomial decay in nonlinear Schrödinger equations
summary: We establish local nonpersistence of full-dimensional invariant tori with polynomially decaying actions for the periodic quintic nonlinear Schrödinger equation \[ iu_t-u_{xx}+T_vu+μ|u|^4u=0,\qquad x\in\mathbb T:=\mathbb R/(2π\mathbb Z). \] For every $κ\geq1$, we construct a fixed bounded real Fourier multiplier $T_ve^{ijx}=v_je^{ijx}$ whose frequencies $λ_j=j^2+v_j$ satisfy the Bourgain-type Diophantine condition \[ \operatorname{dist}\left(\sum_j\ell_jλ_j,\mathbb Z\right) \geqγ_κ\prod_j(1+\ell_j^2\langle j\rangle^{2κ})^{-1} \] for some $γ_κ>0$ and every nonzero finitely supported integer…
